warning: Ground truth is for tests and reviewers. Do NOT feed this file to the agent as prompt input.
headline: Deploy of checkout-api v2.34.0 set the payments-gateway client timeout to 200ms; payments-gateway p95 routinely exceeds 200ms, so most checkout calls fail with upstream timeout (502/504).

likely_cause.change: payments-gateway client timeout reduced from 2000ms to 200ms
likely_cause.impact: Elevated 5xx rate and elevated p95 latency on checkout-api due to upstream timeouts against payments-gateway.

timeline.summary: checkout-api v2.34.0 rolled out to production (10 of 10 pods Ready by 14:04:45Z).
Three checkout-api pods OOMed once during startup and self-recovered (memory pressure from container image change). Not the root cause.
checkout-api 5xx rate climbs from baseline ~0.2 rps to ~14 rps as the v2.34.0 fleet saturates.
Grafana alert CheckoutHighErrorRate fires (5xx ratio > 5% for 1m).
Operator triggers rollback to checkout-api v2.33.4.
5xx rate returns to baseline; Grafana alert resolves.

red_herrings.why_misleading: Three pods restarted once. A surface read can confuse this with crash-loop, but restarts do not continue after 14:05 and request rate is normal during the spike, so this is not the source of 5xx.
red_herrings.evidence_to_disambiguate: metrics/checkout-api-pod-restarts.json shows a single spike then zero; metrics/checkout-api-request-rate.json shows steady traffic, ruling out capacity loss.

fix: Roll back to v2.33.4 or raise the payments-gateway client timeout in v2.34.0 to >= 1500ms.
